claim.title: Claim your account
claim.subtitle: Your admin gave you a username and a one-time invite code. Use them once, choose a password, and you're in.
claim.usernameHint: Exactly as your admin wrote it — not an email address.
claim.inviteHint: Works once. Codes are handed over in person, never emailed.
claim.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. Nothing else is required, so make it long rather than clever.
claim.successHint: Sign in with your username and the password you just chose.
claim.noCode: No code? Your admin can issue one — password resets work the same way.
claim.errInviteRequired: Enter the invite code your admin gave you.
claim.errInviteInvalid: Wrong username or invite code. Check both, or ask your admin to issue a new code.
claim.errInviteExpired: That invite code has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
claim.errAlreadyClaimed: This account has already been claimed. Sign in with your password, or ask your admin to issue a new code.
claim.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
claim.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
claim.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
claim.notConfigured: This build has no backend configured, so accounts can't be claimed.
